testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.wiring.DataManagementLifecycleTests

testcase.name: A - a source with a TEST or a LIVE binding cannot be deleted and nothing is removed()
a credential whose keys do not fit the connector is refused INVALID_CREDENTIAL()
mode is exactly TEST or LIVE - any other spelling is INVALID_PARAMS and nothing is written()
D, E and F - finished idempotency rows do not block, and the delete removes the source, its definitions, snapshots, idempotency rows and credential()
C - expectedVersion that does not match is a 409 CONFLICT and the data source is unchanged()
B - expectedVersion that matches applies the change()
H - when the delete cannot be audited nothing is deleted()
A - a multi-field PATCH is one transaction, one new version and one audit trail()
a PATCH validates every field before it applies any - a bad config, a taken name or a bad status changes nothing()
a PATCH that changes nothing is not a new version and is not audited()
TEST never falls back to LIVE and LIVE never falls back to TEST()
B and C - a RESERVED or UNKNOWN idempotency row (a write in flight or of unknown outcome) blocks the delete()
G - when the vault cannot discard the credential nothing is deleted()
D - when the second step fails the first one is rolled back too()
a binding change that cannot be audited is not applied()
a credential change that cannot be audited is not applied()
E - when the audit sink fails the data source is unchanged()
